name: branch-law-foundation-v1
question: How little of an exact or reference game tree can be retained while preserving decision quality, and can compact branch information outperform the current forcing rule at equal budgets?
status: frozen before tablebase outcome probing or learned-selector fitting
accepted_policy: Forcing-3 remains accepted and is not modified by this development benchmark
exact_domains: KQvK with stronger side normalized to White
KRvK with stronger side normalized to White
KPvK with stronger side normalized to White
exact_truth: Locally probed Syzygy WDL50 and DTZ50 files verified by byte count and SHA-256 before use
state_census: Complete legal fixed-material enumeration, deduplicated by the configured valid geometry symmetry while retaining side to move
partitions: SHA-256 assignment of complete canonical symmetry classes to 60% development, 20% selection, and 20% confirmation
confirmation_guardrail: The foundation command may label development only; selection and confirmation outcomes require a later committed candidate protocol
context: Branch records preserve node role, root candidate, path, remaining depth, and budget even when an initial model omits some fields
baselines: current forcing-category priority then lexical fill
oracle WDL then DTZ ordering as a nondeployable upper reference
all legal branches as the endpoint
primary_curve: retained legal-branch fraction to decision quality preserved
ordinary_north_star: rho_95: minimum nested retained fraction preserving at least 95% of root decisions within 25 cp of the same all-legal reference
exact_north_star: rho_perfect: minimum retained fraction preserving exact WDL on every confirmation state
guardrails: selector parameters, bytes, operations, memory, latency, and retained recursive states
first_candidate_gate: At most one compact candidate may advance only after at least 25% rho_95 reduction, resolved rho_95 improvement, at least 10% resolved regret reduction at the forcing-equivalent budget, catastrophic omission noninferior within one percentage point, resolved refutation-recall improvement, and no total-compute increase.
anti_goal: Do not add conventional engine machinery or expand handcrafted move categories merely for Elo
